Holds.
- Item 2 (`needs_decision` → decision box, never left `pm:dispatched`): step 2's last clause + the script's new refusal `[needs-decision-unreleased]` — the newest `os-dev-report` after the session's newest claim with `status: needs_decision` while the card lacks `needs-user-decision`, refused by name with the decision box as remedy; triage's ⚠️ (not `pm:queue`) honoured. Holds.
- Item 4 (last acts regardless of wording): L39 「收班序列不看维护者措辞:`check-handover.mjs` 退出 0 → 刷正文与标题 → 简报最终一笔。」; the dropped 「继任的释放判据 = 简报在」 lives at seat-lifecycle L14. seat-lifecycle L40 「收班 = 状态 flush + 在飞默认交回队列、不等落地;…」. Holds.
- Payments: old L40 (留守写面 / 评审链载体 / 定时器) → its surviving content in new L35–36; net 0 lines both files; every line ≤120 B (two at exactly 120). Holds.
- Readers imported from their owners (`seat-record.mjs`, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`), no second implementation. Holds.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: `.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing; `skip-changeset` correct; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, matching the claim.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The PR carries NO assignee: the seat's order ruled the omission for this PR on the maintainer's 2026-10-29 words on #27363 (「应该是开发完了你审核通过才会推送给我审核」), which the folded #27345/#27363 dispatch is writing into `os-dev.md` L37; the dev named the conflict with today's os-dev.md text and followed the order — accepted, and the claim's silence on it is corrected by this record (the claim should have carried the ruling; the seat's omission).
- 「Awaiting a human approval」 is read as `needs-user-decision` on the pull — SKILL.md L189's own spelling; a Tier H PR whose seat forgot that label (this seat's own PR #27318 / #27333 earlier this shift carried only `requested_reviewers`) would be refused as not-waiting at sign-off — correct pressure toward the protocol, noted for the seat's own practice.
- Hypotheses 2–4 of the order corrected by measurement (owner of the ACCEPT reader is `seat-record.mjs`; the report must post-date the session's newest claim; `check:pm-governed-prose` / `check:pm-half-states` not derived for these paths) — accepted.
- `check-handover.mjs --self-test` keeps its pre-existing shape (handshake, no battery floor; local-only, no CI job) — Acceptance note, not this card's.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes` 2 (both relay); draft, no flip by anyone; the measured instance has moved (#25805 now `needs-user-decision`, #23181's newest claim names another session) — the rule still stands on the card's words.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's 「下班时卡片应该交回队列,这个应该立卡更新 skills」 and the four-axis frame: a seat that goes home leaves no card locked behind its account — the default flips from stay-behind to hand-back, the one exception is a PR that already passed review and only waits on the queue or an approver, an open `needs_decision` can no longer sit unseen, and the existing patrol enforces exactly that shape with readers borrowed from their owners (AI-error: refusal by name, not tolerance; focus: no new gate, no workflow; long-run: one rule in seat-post-protocol, seat-lifecycle points at it). Holds. Residual: the label-vs-reviewers reading above, which the folded #27345/#27363 PR (approver request as the post-PASS hand-off) will make moot for Tier H.
